description: This PHP source file defines a class `OutcomeByMonthDashlet`, which extends `DashletGenericChart`. The class is responsible for generating a dashboard chart widget in SuiteCRM, particularly visualizing opportunities by month and sales stage, with configurable date ranges and filtering options.

classes.name: OutcomeByMonthDashlet
classes.description: A dashboard widget class that renders a chart showing opportunities grouped by month and stage within SuiteCRM. It provides configuration options for date ranges and filtering by user IDs, and includes methods for constructing data queries and preparing chart data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dashlet with optional parameters and sets default date range if not provided.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Displays configuration options for the dashlet, particularly setting user filter options if none are selected.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates the HTML and JavaScript code to render the chart canvas with data and interactivity.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds the SQL query to retrieve opportunity data grouped by month and sales stage within the specified date range and user filters.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Processes the retrieved data into a format suitable for rendering as a stacked bar chart, including labels, values, and tooltips.
